Subject: FieldLens x NOBE | Student Software Project, Spring 2027

My name is Jordan Lee, a Junior studying Mechanical Engineering at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. I am a Project Manager at NOBE (National Organization for Business and Engineering), a student business and engineering organization on campus.

I noticed that FieldLens publishes field data from its rover runs as downloadable reports. Our software team could build a web dashboard that lets growers compare runs across plots and seasons, connected to the data format you already export.

We propose a 12-week project from January to April, with an option to continue into the fall. All we ask is a short check-in with your team every week or two. Our members get real software engineering experience, and you get a dedicated student team working on a problem you care about.

I have also attached a brief overview of NOBE for your reference. Would you be open to a 20-minute call to talk through what a project could look like? I can send a Calendar Invite for whatever time works best.

Looking forward to hearing from you!
